1235 PM CDT Sun Oct 11 2026

This Outlook is for Northwest and West Central Arkansas as well as
much of Eastern Oklahoma.

.DAY ONE...This Afternoon and Tonight.

FIRE WEATHER DANGER.
RISK...Limited.
AREA...Northeast Oklahoma.
ONSET...Ongoing.

DISCUSSION...
Unseasonably warm temperatures and gusty winds will worsen 
grassland fire weather conditions through this afternoon, 
especially across northeast Oklahoma. Any fire starts could 
spread quickly this afternoon.

SPOTTER AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT ACTION STATEMENT...
Spotter Activation Not Expected.

.DAYS TWO THROUGH SEVEN...Monday through Saturday.
MONDAY...High Wind Potential.
TUESDAY...Thunderstorm Potential.
WEDNESDAY...Thunderstorm Potential...Heavy Rain Potential.
THURSDAY...Thunderstorm...High Wind...and Heavy Rain Potential.
FRIDAY...High Wind Potential.
SATURDAY...No Hazards.

EXTENDED DISCUSSION...
Gusty winds will continue on Monday which will again increase
grassland fire weather concerns. Thunderstorm chances increase
Tuesday night with widespread showers and thunderstorms forecast
Wednesday through Thursday. Heavy rainfall amounts may occur,
especially across northeast Oklahoma, raising the potential for 
localized flooding. A limited threat for severe weather may also 
develop. A cold front passes by late week bringing drier and 
cooler weather for the weekend.
